[2026-09-14 | 300760.SZ | Hold | -1.3% | -3.9% | 5d]

DECISION:
**Rating**: Hold

**Executive Summary**: 维持 300760.SZ 为 Hold：现有中性核心仓位不加不减，不因短线跌破 10 EMA/VWMA 而恐慌清仓，也不在 165 附近追多。新建或加仓须等待价格有效收复 164.90–165.00 并进一步站上 167.51（200 SMA），或回踩 161.20–162.50 缩量企稳后小步介入；收盘跌破 161.20 先减 20%–30%，有效跌破 153.52（50 SMA）转防御，155.5 作为硬止损。时间 3–6 个月，按双向确认信号分批调整。

**Investment Thesis**: 综合三方意见，采纳中立分析师“有条件中性持有”的框架：既不接受激进派把 300760.SZ 当作已确认的进攻点，也不接受保守派在中期支撑未破时提前砍半。多头的事实基础成立但被前置了——2026 Q2 收入同比 +10.5%、单季净利 +1.1% 转正，50 SMA 上行且价格高于其约 6%，50/200 均线收敛；184 亿净现金、有息负债仅 3.11 亿、ROE 18.51%、股息率 2.61%、Beta 0.185 提供资产负债表托底；前瞻 EPS 7.91 对 TTM 6.49 隐含约 +22% 修复，前瞻 PE 约 20.56 倍不算极端。但盈利拐点证据仍脆弱：H1 归母净利仍 -5.4%，净利率由 31.9%→27.9%→26.3% 连续下滑，TTM 净利 78.64 亿低于 2025 全年 81.36 亿，收入增长尚未转化为利润，前瞻 EPS 仍只是卖方预期而非已实现事实。空头在“当下不能确认拐点”上更有说服力：价格 162.73 已跌破 10 EMA 164.90 与 VWMA 165.00，MACD 3.894<4.155 死叉、RSI 69.93→54.33，9 月 9 日放量下跌且主力连续净流出；P/B 4.86、EV/EBITDA 约 15.8 倍、市值/FCF 约 27.5 倍并不便宜；商誉+无形资产 175.14 亿占总资产 28.8%、应收账款 37.54 亿、存货 56.5 亿、2025 Q4 单季仅 5.66 亿、H 股折价风险未消。不过空头直接 SELL 或砍半也过头：50 SMA 153.52 未失守、中期修复结构尚未证伪，低 Beta、涨跌停限制与 184 亿净现金使跳空风险相对可控，这仍是优质龙头在弱周期中的估值消化而非基本面恶化。因此在方向证据相互制衡下不制造方向，维持 Hold，以 161.20 和 164.90–167.51 作为向下减仓、向上加仓的确认触发；若 H 股定价深度折价、商誉减值或单季净利重新恶化，需重新评估评级。

**Price Target**: 174.67

**Time Horizon**: 3-6个月

REFLECTION:
The Hold was directionally wrong on a relative basis: raw -1.3% and alpha -3.9% vs 399001.SZ over the 3-6 month window, and the 174.67 target never approached. The bearish technical read held correctly — price never reclaimed 164.90–165.00 or the 167.51 200 SMA, confirming the MACD death cross and distribution signal — while the bull thesis's core premise (forward EPS recovery from an unconfirmed earnings inflection) failed to convert into price. The error was framing a neutral Hold around a bullish 174.67 target and add-on-reclaim triggers when the confirmed evidence favored the downside trigger. Lesson for next time: when price sits below the 10 EMA/VWMA with bearish momentum and the earnings inflection is still only a sell-side estimate, treat the reduce-on-break level as the base case and cut the position rather than holding a disguised long.

[2026-09-28 | 1024.HK | Underweight | -1.7%]

Next time, when the expected alpha is this thin, require a clearer near-term catalyst or express the view through a relative-value pair or option structure rather than a standalone Underweight.

[2026-09-21 | 0939.HK | Hold | -0.8%]
The neutral Hold call was correct: 0939.HK returned -0.8% in absolute terms but delivered +0.8% alpha versus ^HSI, so refusing to add at HK$9.59 preserved relative capital. The short-term momentum warning and no-chase framework held as price failed to break HK$9.99 and stayed below VWMA, while the low-valuation/high-dividend downside buffer only partially held—it limited relative damage but did not prevent a small absolute loss, and the profit-quality concern (provisions/charge-offs +20.8% versus net profit +4.6%) correctly argued against upgrading. Next time, separate relative alpha from absolute return explicitly and require profit-quality or cash-flow confirmation, not just cheap valuation and dividend yield, before authorizing even conditional add-on tranches.

[2026-09-21 | 0941.HK | Hold | +0.1%]
The Hold call was directionally acceptable rather than strongly right: raw return was only +0.1%, but alpha versus ^HSI was +1.7%, so avoiding a chase and staying invested captured modest relative outperformance. The defensive cash-flow/dividend cushion and low-leverage valuation support held, while the bullish breakout catalyst failed to materialize and the FCF-vs-dividend coverage gap remained the unresolved bear risk. Lesson for next similar analysis: when evidence conflicts into a neutral rating, benchmark the decision versus ^HSI and pre-commit to price/FCF triggers rather than treating low-volume technical compression as an actionable setup.
